humu.description: Payment institution focused on digital financial solutions — transfers, payments and financial management for businesses and consumers.

tech-lead.title: Tech Lead
tech-lead.summary: I lead the frontend of a payment institution — web and mobile, under data protection law (LGPD).
responsibilities: I lead the frontend team: architecture, code quality and decisions that need to last.
I define the technical roadmap for web and mobile, balancing delivery, scale and regulatory compliance.
I own release planning, CI/CD pipelines and whatever runs in production.
I maintain observability in Grafana and Kibana: dashboards, alerts and log pipelines.
achievements: Migrated the mobile architecture to a modular, scalable structure with higher test coverage.
Standardized frontend practices across web and mobile, reducing bugs and rework.
Became the technical point of contact for compliance, ensuring adherence to LGPD.
Improved observability to the point of detecting performance degradation before users notice.

desenvolvedor-senior.title: Senior Front-end Developer
desenvolvedor-senior.summary: I built financial interfaces, web and mobile, in an environment where getting data wrong is expensive.
responsibilities: Developed secure, responsive React interfaces for financial flows.
Modeled reusable components with accessibility and visual consistency.
Worked alongside backend and security teams on data integrity and regulatory requirements (LGPD).
Helped define the mobile architecture, aiming at decoupling and testability.
achievements: Delivered the bank slip (boleto) issuance and reconciliation features.
Took part in the mobile architecture overhaul that became the team's foundation.

signo.description: Software house building tailor-made solutions, delivering scalable products for clients across very different industries.

desenvolvedor-front-end.title: Front-end Developer
desenvolvedor-front-end.summary: A new client every cycle: from e-commerce to mobile apps, always with the product live at the end.
responsibilities: Developed and optimized interfaces in React and Next.js.
Designed project architectures with scale and component reuse in mind.
Integrated external APIs in a secure and maintainable way.
Led technical teams on web and mobile applications, with code review and mentoring.
achievements: Introduced frontend security practices, preventing vulnerabilities in critical systems.
Reduced application load times with caching and lazy loading.
Raised unit and integration test coverage, cutting down the incidence of bugs.
Introduced CI/CD pipelines, automating deploys and taking human error out of production.
